resources.string: Lets Solis lock your screen and pull down the notification shade.

Solis uses this service only to perform two actions when you ask for them: locking the screen after you interrupt an impulse, and pulling down the notification shade when you swipe down on the home screen. While it is on, Android also lets Solis show its own lock screen when the screen turns off, if you turned that on in Solis settings. Solis cannot see, read or collect anything on your screen.
